messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will give you a three‑day weekend; if they fall on a weekend you’ll still get a “long weekend” but it may be a four‑day stretch if you take a day off):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Typical Long‑Weekend Length |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-----------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Sunday | 4 days (Dec 30–Jan 2) |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | 3 days (Feb 18–20) |
| Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | 3 days (Feb 18–20) |
| St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario) | Mar 17 (Friday) | Friday | 3 days (Mar 15–17) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Friday | 3 days (Apr 5–7) |
| Easter Monday (Federal employees) | Apr 10 (Monday) | Monday | 3 days (Apr 8–10) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | Monday | 3 days (May 20–22) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Saturday | 4 days (Jun 30–Jul 3) |
| Civic Holiday (most provinces) | Aug 7 (Monday) | Monday | 3 days (Aug 5–7) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Monday | 3 days (Sep 2–4) |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 (Monday) | Monday | 3 days (Oct 7–9) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Monday) | Monday | 3 days (Nov 9–11) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | Monday | 3 days (Dec 23–25) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Tuesday | 3 days (Dec 24–26) |

**Notes**

* **New Year’s Day** falls on a Sunday, so you’ll get a four‑day break if you take the preceding Friday (Dec 30) off.
* **Victoria Day** is celebrated on the Monday preceding May 25, so it’s always a Monday.
* **Civic Holiday** is observed on the first Monday in August in most provinces (except Quebec, where it’s called Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day on June 24).
* Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., **St. Patrick’s Day** in Ontario, **Louis Riel Day** in Manitoba, **Family Day** in Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba). If you’re planning trips in those provinces, you’ll have extra long weekends.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the list broken down by province or if you need anything else!
